description: Search books in catalog by free-text query and pagination. For browse scenarios use dedicated tools (books_by_genre/author/language/format). Every item carries `warnings` (show them to the user together with the book), `age_rating`/`age_gate` (`age_gate`=true means 18+ material), and `ad_label`/`advertiser` (the product link is advertising).
name: books_search
